name: Coma Cluster, field COMA4-2 (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the core of the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: coma42-hubble
story: One tile of Hubble's mosaic of the crowded heart of the Coma Cluster, surveyed to find faint dwarf galaxies among the cluster's thousands of members.

claims.text: COMA4-2 is a tile of the survey's core mosaic
The Coma Cluster is also known as Abell 1656, one of the nearest rich galaxy clusters
The Hubble Coma survey imaged the core and infall region of Coma, focusing on dwarf galaxies among thousands of galaxies
